name: textarea
title: Textarea
description: Solid textarea component with invalid state styling hooks.

meta.customization: Use the ui-textarea class and data-invalid attribute for resize, border, and validation-state styles.

parity.baseUi: Thin UI textarea follows Base UI Input/Field direction for native textarea semantics, invalid/disabled styling data, and form participation. Gaps: autosize helpers, field registration, validation lifecycle, filled/focused state data, and character count composition remain follow-up work.
parity.kobalte: Comparable to Kobalte TextField textarea usage when composed with Field. Gaps: no standalone Keystone TextArea primitive for form-control ownership, reset listener behavior, or description/error ID registration yet.
